{"operationName":"SearchProductQuery","variables":{"brand":"1800flowers","term":"blue+flowers","productOptions":{"orderBy":"BEST_SELLERS","pageSize":36,"page":1,"noRedirect":false},"environment":"production","targeting":[{"key":"entryBrand","value":""},{"key":"url","value":"/searchterm/blue+flowers"},{"key":"browserUUID","value":"2b4da444-a5d7-4d2d-b89d-f9a748ca6ae0"},{"key":"pageType","value":"searchterm"},{"key":"pageURL","value":"https://www.1800flowers.com/searchterm/blue+flowers?searchTerm=blue_flowers"}]},"query":"query SearchProductQuery($brand: String!, $productOptions: ProductOptions, $environment: String!, $term: String!, $semanticSearchEnabled: Boolean, $targeting: [Targeting]) {
  findProductsBySearchTerm(
    brand: $brand
    environment: $environment
    term: $term
    productOptions: $productOptions
    semanticSearchEnabled: $semanticSearchEnabled
    targeting: $targeting
  ) {
    redirectUrl
    productFacets {
      name
      value
      type
      displayOpen
      entries {
        name
        value
        from
        to
        count
        __typename
      }
      __typename
    }
    products {
      id
      productSkus {
        id
        __typename
      }
      brandId
      reviews
      image {
        altText
        name
        path
        snipe
        snipeProductEndDate
        snipeCategoryEndDate
        snipeProductStartDate
        snipeCategoryStartDate
        __typename
      }
      partNumber
      baseCode
      prices {
        currency
        type
        value
        __typename
      }
      skuPriceRange {
        sale {
          value
          __typename
        }
        retail {
          value
          __typename
        }
        __typename
      }
      name
      brand
      seo {
        url
        __typename
      }
      productType
      availability {
        availabilityIndicator
        deliveryDateType
        displayEndDate
        displayStartDate
        earliestShipDate
        latestShipDate
        perishable
        productDeliveryType
        shipAlone
        deliveryMessage
        __typename
      }
      __typename
    }
    totalPages
    totalProducts
    originalQuery
    canShowResultsFor
    showingResultsFor
    experiments
    __typename
  }
}
"}

{"operationName":"SearchProductQuery","variables":{"brand":"1800flowers","term":"green+flower","productOptions":{"orderBy":"BEST_SELLERS","pageSize":36,"page":1,"noRedirect":false},"environment":"production","targeting":[{"key":"entryBrand","value":""},{"key":"url","value":"/searchterm/green+flower"},{"key":"browserUUID","value":"2b4da444-a5d7-4d2d-b89d-f9a748ca6ae0"},{"key":"pageType","value":"searchterm"},{"key":"pageURL","value":"https://www.1800flowers.com/searchterm/green+flower"}]},"query":"query SearchProductQuery($brand: String!, $productOptions: ProductOptions, $environment: String!, $term: String!, $semanticSearchEnabled: Boolean, $targeting: [Targeting]) {
  findProductsBySearchTerm(
    brand: $brand
    environment: $environment
    term: $term
    productOptions: $productOptions
    semanticSearchEnabled: $semanticSearchEnabled
    targeting: $targeting
  ) {
    redirectUrl
    productFacets {
      name
      value
      type
      displayOpen
      entries {
        name
        value
        from
        to
        count
        __typename
      }
      __typename
    }
    products {
      id
      productSkus {
        id
        __typename
      }
      brandId
      reviews
      image {
        altText
        name
        path
        snipe
        snipeProductEndDate
        snipeCategoryEndDate
        snipeProductStartDate
        snipeCategoryStartDate
        __typename
      }
      partNumber
      baseCode
      prices {
        currency
        type
        value
        __typename
      }
      skuPriceRange {
        sale {
          value
          __typename
        }
        retail {
          value
          __typename
        }
        __typename
      }
      name
      brand
      seo {
        url
        __typename
      }
      productType
      availability {
        availabilityIndicator
        deliveryDateType
        displayEndDate
        displayStartDate
        earliestShipDate
        latestShipDate
        perishable
        productDeliveryType
        shipAlone
        deliveryMessage
        __typename
      }
      __typename
    }
    totalPages
    totalProducts
    originalQuery
    canShowResultsFor
    showingResultsFor
    experiments
    __typename
  }
}
"}

{"operationName":"SearchProductQuery","variables":{"brand":"1800flowers","term":"yellow+flower","productOptions":{"orderBy":"BEST_SELLERS","pageSize":36,"page":1,"noRedirect":false},"environment":"production","targeting":[{"key":"entryBrand","value":""},{"key":"url","value":"/searchterm/yellow+flower"},{"key":"browserUUID","value":"2b4da444-a5d7-4d2d-b89d-f9a748ca6ae0"},{"key":"pageType","value":"searchterm"},{"key":"pageURL","value":"https://www.1800flowers.com/searchterm/yellow+flower"}]},"query":"query SearchProductQuery($brand: String!, $productOptions: ProductOptions, $environment: String!, $term: String!, $semanticSearchEnabled: Boolean, $targeting: [Targeting]) {
  findProductsBySearchTerm(
    brand: $brand
    environment: $environment
    term: $term
    productOptions: $productOptions
    semanticSearchEnabled: $semanticSearchEnabled
    targeting: $targeting
  ) {
    redirectUrl
    productFacets {
      name
      value
      type
      displayOpen
      entries {
        name
        value
        from
        to
        count
        __typename
      }
      __typename
    }
    products {
      id
      productSkus {
        id
        __typename
      }
      brandId
      reviews
      image {
        altText
        name
        path
        snipe
        snipeProductEndDate
        snipeCategoryEndDate
        snipeProductStartDate
        snipeCategoryStartDate
        __typename
      }
      partNumber
      baseCode
      prices {
        currency
        type
        value
        __typename
      }
      skuPriceRange {
        sale {
          value
          __typename
        }
        retail {
          value
          __typename
        }
        __typename
      }
      name
      brand
      seo {
        url
        __typename
      }
      productType
      availability {
        availabilityIndicator
        deliveryDateType
        displayEndDate
        displayStartDate
        earliestShipDate
        latestShipDate
        perishable
        productDeliveryType
        shipAlone
        deliveryMessage
        __typename
      }
      __typename
    }
    totalPages
    totalProducts
    originalQuery
    canShowResultsFor
    showingResultsFor
    experiments
    __typename
  }
}
"}
